name: Ilse Harrow
silhouette: Solid, sleeves rolled, apron over a reeve's chain, a tally slate.
speech_rhythm: Plain. One clause, then the price. 'Keeper' without warmth until earned, then no title at all.
public_motivation: Dry cellars, fair rent, work for the town.
private_motivation: Her son drowned after the Y44 riot; the town must never rise and never be pushed again.
fear: The town burning its own bridges.
contradiction: The moderate who runs the town's only illegal water sale.
secret: The brewery well is fed by a crack from the pound; the ale is Company water.
